metric: raw unsmoothed evaluation closest to 5M; no time-weighted metric or interpolation
parser_limits: simple_value scalar records; lengths checked; CRC not validated; no pickle deserialization
comparison_scope: same backbone/candidate initialization; map-specific hidden path held fixed; direct uses its own target and one TD loss, so this is a whole-framework comparison, not a gate-only ablation
decision: retain both directions; complete 3s79 and 6h87/88/90 under the same definition before generalizing; no extra RMS experiments
summary_field_scope: near_5m is used for matched budget comparison; last/last_five/point_count/max_win_rate cover each complete recorded run and some historical BM runs extend to 10M; last_five_within_5_05m provides the corresponding budget-limited tail
